_comment: Copy this to config/league.json and fill it in for YOUR league. It is gitignored (league-specific). Used by scraping/scrape_league.py and draft_sheets/build_tool_data.py.
_league_id: Your ESPN league id (the number in the fantasy.espn.com/…/leagues/<THIS> URL). Leave 0 to AUTO-DISCOVER from your cookies (scrape_league.py picks it, or lists them if you're in more than one).
_me: The team you are drafting. Leave blank to AUTO-DETECT (scrape_league.py matches your SWID to the league members). If set, must match a manager name from the scrape (ESPN owner display name). The console tracks THIS team's budget, roster and needs.
_projections_xlsm: Path to the checked-in Elboberto projections workbook (the universal baseline). build_tool_data.py reads its CheatSheet + LeagueInfo sheets.
_my_mult: Optional positional tilt for YOUR max-bid model (how much you value each position vs. baseline). 1.0 = neutral. Raise a position to pay up for it. Leave neutral until you have a strategy.
